labels.what: A .env file is committed to git (tracked). Contents not read in this review; check whether it holds only the public Supabase URL and key or also secret values
Anyone, including signed-out visitors, can insert into new_member_applications (WITH CHECK true); the table holds applicant personal details, so spam and fake rows are possible
Signed-out visitors can read chapter fees (USING true); reference data, likely intended
Any signed-in user can read every roster member row (USING true); roster has names and emails, so any member account sees all members
Most edge functions have verify_jwt = false (only one is true); each function must do its own login check, and roster-import does (admin role check) but other functions were not all checked
CORS allows any origin on an admin function that uses the service role key (the function checks the caller's admin role first)
Fixed 800 ms wait, then toast 'Refreshing to get the latest version' and a hard reload whether or not an update exists; harmless
Session token stored in localStorage and shared with framing parents by postMessage; origin list includes http://localhost:3000 in dev
Fallback quote slots and Math.random shuffling for a newsletter-style 'squawk' feed when no real content exists; content is generated, not stored
